SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL RECALL NOTICE

VOLUNTARY NATIONWIDE RECALL
Company: Northgate Generics LLC
Date: April 22, 2026
Product: Metrovane (metformin hydrochloride extended-release) 500 mg and 750 mg tablets
Lot Numbers: NG24117, NG24118, NG24131
Recall Classification: Class II

Northgate Generics LLC is voluntarily recalling three lots of Metrovane extended-release tablets to the retail level due to dissolution test results that failed to meet specifications at the 12-month stability time point. Out-of-specification dissolution may result in reduced or delayed drug release, potentially leading to inadequate glycemic control. To date, Northgate has received no reports of adverse events related to this recall. Pharmacies and wholesalers should immediately stop distribution, quarantine affected lots, and return product using the instructions provided by the company's recall coordinator. Patients should continue taking their medication until a replacement is obtained, as stopping abruptly may pose a greater risk. The recall is being conducted with the knowledge of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Distributors must complete and return the recall response form within 14 days.

key_requirements: Stop distribution and quarantine lots NG24117, NG24118, NG24131
Return affected product per recall coordinator instructions
Distributors return recall response form within 14 days
Patients continue therapy until replacement is obtained
output.summary: Class II retail-level recall of three Metrovane ER lots for failed dissolution at stability testing; no adverse events reported.
